name: tera-study-conversation-short
description: Tera vertical short: a natural two-person conversation that resolves one study objection.

scenes.title: Objection
scenes.narration: Student: I already made notes. Why would I need more questions? Friend: Because notes show what you saw, not what you can remember.

scenes.title: Known pain
scenes.narration: Student: But I know it when I read it. Friend: That is exactly why the exam can feel harder than revision.

scenes.title: Specific proof
scenes.narration: Friend: Pick one topic. Put the notes away. Explain it in your own words, then answer three questions. The answer you miss is your next study task.

scenes.title: CTA
scenes.narration: Student: So I should test first? Friend: Exactly. Use Tera to create the questions and expose the gaps.
